svg.title: MarketBrain target architecture
svg.desc: A data-first, news-corroborated, risk-governed and human-approved architecture for personal Indian-market research and paper trading.
svg.text: Data first · News corroborated · Risk governed · Human approved
Deterministic prices, membership and execution inputs
Near-real-time evidence with explicit usage rights

g.text: NSE · BSE · SEBI · RBI · Company IR
Enabled only after terms or written consent
• Store only licensed fields and permitted snippets
• Full text: short retention only when licensed
• Metadata: 12 months · derived facts: policy based
Audited cleanup for stale licensed content
No repeated alert for the same story cluster

svg.text: Governed ingestion, features, evidence and decisions

g.text: Backtested and calibrated; news may raise, lower or veto
Portfolio, liquidity, validity zone and news-risk policy
Java baseline, signed contributions and async job
AI holding review; risk remains final

svg.text: Docker: Spring Boot API + React UI
